say:6:1012221001:1.text: Please take the medicine she brought. It'll make you feel better.
say:6:1012221001:1.source_cn: 孩子们，这位姐姐带来的草药可以放心服用，乖乖吃下去，病...

say:7:1012221002:1.text: If you say so, Miss Florabelle... It's so bitter...
say:7:1012221002:1.source_cn: 老师都这么说的话……可是，草药很苦……

say:8:1012221003:0.text: Finish all your medicine, and I'll give you your favorite candies.
say:8:1012221003:0.source_cn: 别怕！只要你喝完药，我就把最喜欢的糖果给你吃！

say:11:1012221004:1.text: If you don't take your medicine, your stomachaches will get worse. Please listen to Miss Florabelle.
say:11:1012221004:1.source_cn: 再不喝药，肚子会更痛，你最好听老师的话。

say:12:1012221005:1.text:
*Cry*... Okay...
Ah, it tastes so bad!
say:12:1012221005:1.source_cn: 呜……好吧……\n咕嘟咕嘟——果然很苦！

say:13:1012221006:1.text: But my belly feels better now... all warm...
say:13:1012221006:1.source_cn: 不过……肚子暖暖的，很舒服……

say:14:1012221007:0.text: Now that you've taken your medicine, Why don't you all go rest by the tree for a while? Miss Florabelle needs to express her gratitude to these guests.
say:14:1012221007:0.source_cn: 刚吃完药，不要乱跑，你们去树下歇息一会儿吧。老师要向客...

say:17:1012221008:1.text: The teacher that Granny Fennel mentioned really was you. It's been a long time, Florabelle.
say:17:1012221008:1.source_cn: 茴姆婆婆说的那位老师果然是你。好久不见，芙拉贝尔。

say:18:1012221009:0.text: Eironn, are you finding it difficult to practice the way of the sword? There's a haunted look in your eyes.
say:18:1012221009:0.source_cn: 埃隆，修行剑道的旅途不太顺利吗？你的眼中蒙着一层阴影呢。

say:22:1012221011:0.text: Florabelle, you should've already guessed that something is wrong in the Dark Forest... Otherwise, we wouldn't have come to the Vaduso Mountains.
say:22:1012221011:0.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔，你这是明知故问吗？你应该猜到薄暮丛林出事了…...

say:23:1012221012:0.text: It's been a while, Lyca. You did not even greet me properly. Alas, after graduation, you no longer see me as one of your schoolmates.
say:23:1012221012:0.source_cn: 莱卡，许久没见，你都不和我好好打个招呼。唉……毕业后，...

say:24:1012221013:0.text: How I miss those days when you used to admire me and follow me around all the time... You were like sheet moss on a rock, clinging to me day and night.
say:24:1012221013:0.source_cn: 真怀念上学那会儿，那时候你最喜欢我跟着我，就像是鬼针草...

say:26:1012221015:0.text: Hmm... Oh, that's right. I almost forgot that you were always crying on my shoulder about every little thing.
say:26:1012221015:0.source_cn: 嗯……也对，我差点忘了你总是趴在我身上哭的事情。

say:29:1012221016:0.text: Wow... this is the first time I've seen Lyca at a loss for words.
say:29:1012221016:0.source_cn: 哇哦……我还是第一次见到莱卡手足无措的模样。

say:30:1012221017:0.text: Hey, you're Lorsan, aren't you? You've grown. Did your sister miss me after I left the Dark Forest?
say:30:1012221017:0.source_cn: 哎？你是洛桑吧，都这么大了。我离开薄暮丛林这些年，你姐...

say:33:1012221018:0.text: Your poor taste in jokes is as bad as ever, Florabelle. I had thought you would be more reserved once you became a teacher.
say:33:1012221018:0.source_cn: 你的恶趣味还是一如既往，芙拉贝尔。我以为你当上老师后会...

say:34:1012221019:0.text: What are you talking about? The kids love me. You won't find another teacher with a youthful mindset like mine.
say:34:1012221019:0.source_cn: 这是什么话？我这样心态年轻的老师可不多见哦，孩子们都很...

say:35:1012221020:0.text: Anyway, old friends coming to see me is one thing, but meeting you, <style="highlight">Magister Merlin</style>, is an honor.
say:35:1012221020:0.source_cn: 好啦，话说回来。我猜到老朋友们要来找我了，还有您——<...
say:35:1012221020:0.male: Anyway, old friends coming to see me is one thing, but meeting you, <style="highlight">Magister Merlin</style>, is an honor.
say:35:1012221020:0.female: Anyway, old friends coming to see me is one thing, but meeting you, <style="highlight">Magister Merlin</style>, is an honor.

say:37:1012221021:0.source_cn: 这是我第一次与您见面，但您的事迹，我早有耳闻。
say:37:1012221021:0.male: This is the first time we've met, but I've heard a lot about you.
say:37:1012221021:0.female: This is the first time we've met, but I've heard a lot about you.

say:38:1012221022:0.text: Wait... we've all heard of Merlin, but none of us guessed his identity on our first try. How did you know?

say:41:1012221023:0.text: I'm the one who told Florabelle.

narration:45:1012243:0.text: Just as you engage in a conversation with the little Bulbsprites, Florabelle shows up.
narration:45:1012243:0.source_cn: 就在你们与小花灵聊天的过程中，芙拉贝尔出现了。
